worldcombat.skill.teeterdance.summary: A wobbly dance: every living thing around the user except itself is pulled into the rhythm and left confused — unsteady, drifting as it walks, and likely to fumble an action. It spares no one, allies included; stand outside the radius and it never touches you.
worldcombat.skill.teeterdance.use.0: Daze a whole circle when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.teeterdance.use.1: Break up the footwork and actions of close-range fighters
worldcombat.skill.teeterdance.descriptio: Centred on the user, the rhythm reaches a radius of %1$s blocks; every living thing inside except the user is dazed for %2$s, staggered a step every 12 ticks and likely to fumble an action.
worldcombat.skill.teeterdance.careful.on: Considerate: friendlies inside are spared, at the cost of radius x0.8, duration x0.8, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown x1.1.
worldcombat.skill.teeterdance.careful.of: All-out: everyone inside except the user sways, allies included; wider, longer and cheaper.
worldcombat.skill.teeterdance.descriptio: Each stagger is about %1$s blocks and each action attempted has about %1$s x0.9 chance to be wasted.
Wind-up %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s. The wind-up can be interrupted at no cost.
worldcombat.skill.teeterdance.timing: The dance reaches %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP and cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.teeterdance.preference: On (Considerate): friendlies inside are spared, at the cost of radius x0.8, duration x0.8, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown x1.1. Off (All-out): everyone inside except the user sways, allies included, for a wider, longer, cheaper dance.
The partner only considers dancing while a threat is this close; larger makes it charge in before dancing.
At least this many enemies must stand inside the dance radius; 1 dances on a single foe, larger waits until surrounded.
world_combat.move.teeterdance.text.stead: No one caught the rhythm (%1$s blocks)
worldcombat.skill.teeterdance.descriptio: The daze wears off over time or can be removed early by cleansing effects; it stays on whoever was caught, so it keeps going even after they leave the circle.
